title: Wynnewood Back to School
summary: Watch Wynnewood Back to School and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog.
body_markdown:
As students across Dallas return to the classroom, Wynnewood Village helped ensure hundreds of local families were ready for the year ahead.


Through a community-wide Back to School event, more than 800 students received backpacks filled with school supplies, along with access to free immunizations, shoes, hygiene kits, food, and other essential resources. The event was made possible through the support of community partners including Target, Parkland Health, Gupta Dental, Accident & Injury, and Smucker's, all of whom came together with a shared goal: investing in the success of local students.


Our centers serve as more than places to shop. They are gathering places that bring communities together, provide valuable resources, and create meaningful local impact.
